description: Read one seasonal upkeep reserve by its id, which is keyless, or list the reserves one wallet holds, which is a signed read that only that wallet can make. For each: open or withdrawn, the cycle that is active, the needs and what each is waiting on, and, only where the place is shown, the NET it stands for (a house reference, not a price) and which packets are linked. For a place that is not shown a read by id says the NET figure is not shown and names no packet; the holder's own signed reply and signed list always show them. A read by id shows no wallet, no name, no words of the holder, no evidence reference and no pin: a place is shown only as a 350 metre cell, and only public ground a listed verifier has confirmed; any other place is not shown at all, and a list by wallet carries no place. To list by wallet, call with the wallet alone to get MESSAGE_TO_SIGN, sign it with that wallet (personal_sign, free, no gas), then call again with the wallet, the nonce and the signature within 5 minutes: a signature is good for one list, and a request without a valid one is refused the same way for every wallet. It says plainly that the NET is not held: a reserve is a record, never custody and never a lock. Free; a read by id is keyless, and a list is signed by the holder's own wallet, never by a key. Cost and signer: free; a read by id is keyless, a list by wallet is signed by that wallet itself with no gas, and the house never holds a key.

nonce.description: With wallet: the time in milliseconds the list is signed at, within 5 minutes of the board's time. The first answer gives you one; pass the same number back with the signature.

reserveId.description: The reserve's id (the commissionId it was committed under). A read by id is keyless: nothing to sign.

signature.description: With wallet and nonce: the 0x… personal_sign output over MESSAGE_TO_SIGN, made by that same wallet. Good for one list.

wallet.description: Or the 0x… address of a holder, to list its reserves. A list by wallet is a signed read: call with the wallet alone to get MESSAGE_TO_SIGN. Address only, never a private key.

name: net_reserve_status
title: Where a seasonal upkeep reserve stands, or every reserve one wallet holds (a signed read)
